headline: Google Resolves Cloud Outage Impacting UK Banks and Websites
summary: Google resolved a cloud outage that temporarily took down banking services for customers of Revolut and disrupted various UK websites.
why: Cloud infrastructure providers host critical digital services for financial institutions; unexpected outages cause widespread operational disruptions.

impacts.name: Cloud Computing
impacts.why: Technical failures in cloud infrastructure disrupt digital banking and online commerce, highlighting operational resilience risks.
